title: Agent tools for Papyrus sites: remote MCP and WebMCP
description: Follow-up to agent-readable pages (PPY-f172d7): expose search/read (and later authorized actions) to external agents via a remote MCP server per site, and evaluate WebMCP for in-browser agents. Builds on the newsroom CLI/GraphQL surface. Not started.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Re-parented 2026-10-21 from PPY-bcfd2d to the headless-delivery epic PPY-29da48 (Markus for everything). MCP and WebMCP are not part of the standard-front-end goal; not built, status unchanged (open, P3). The agent-readable page layer it builds on is live: per-page Markdown twins, llms.txt, Accept negotiation.
